title: Caffeine Half-Life Risk Before Bedtime
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:caffeine
| search estimated_active_mg=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(estimated_active_mg) as avg_active_mg max(estimated_active_mg) as max_active_mg by _time weekday
| sort - _time
description: Tracks remaining caffeine at bedtime over time and breaks it out by weekday.
value: Estimated active caffeine at bedtime makes the invisible carryover of a late cup much easier to respect.
implementation: Send remaining caffeine at bedtime events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of remaining caffeine at bedtime by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how remaining caffeine at bedtime changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
